entries.title: 1 · Before — iPhone
entries.changed: Nothing yet: the baseline.
entries.working: Home, Cosmos, Chat Universe cards, chat windows.
entries.failed: Apps opened over the Universe reported success but were invisible; LÉLU's figure painted over chat content; three stacked headers on a phone.

entries.title: 1 · Before — desktop and landscape
entries.changed: Nothing yet.
entries.working: Chat window with markdown and images.
entries.failed: Projects, Browser and Engineering Studio opened invisibly behind the chat; no layout system.

entries.title: 2 · Workspace Steward — phone
entries.changed: One plan for every window (WorkspaceSteward over SpatialModel). On a phone, one window is the screen; the rest are tabs that keep running.
entries.working: Newest window fills the screen; split in landscape; 'why' shows reasons and 0 model calls.
entries.failed: First version picked the oldest maximised window and showed folded windows through the old modal path — fixed before this capture.

entries.title: 2 · Workspace Steward — desktop
entries.changed: The same four windows that were hidden now tile without overlap; LÉLU's workspace.arrange tool and the bar's modes drive it.
entries.working: Auto, tile, split, focus, stack, full.
entries.failed: The bar overlapped the Universe composer; fixed by letting windows own the workspace.

entries.title: 3 · Conversation stages — desktop
entries.changed: Cinematic, Gallery, Present (Motion), Board (React Flow) and 3D (existing three/R3F/drei) built from the same stored messages.
entries.working: All six stages render real content.
entries.incomplete: 3D takes ~3s to appear on a phone-sized production build (chunk + textures).

entries.title: 3 · Conversation stages — iPhone
entries.changed: The same stages on a phone sheet.
entries.working: All stages; board re-fits to the sheet.

entries.title: 4 · Self-evolution by words
entries.changed: Typed 'Turn this into a visual research board' and 'Make this cinematic' into the composer.
entries.working: DirectResolver ran workspace.stage locally; reply provider lelu-direct; 0 model calls; network showed only local status/event endpoints.

entries.title: 5 · Browser — desktop
entries.changed: Tabs with history, full-height page, Reader, Beside chat (steward split), To board (page becomes a board source).
entries.working: Real Wikipedia renders in-app.
entries.failed: GitHub refuses embedding; the first watchdog missed it because Chrome fires load for the error page. Now the server returns an 'embeddable' verdict and the tab offers Reader/Open.

entries.title: 5 · Browser — iPhone
entries.changed: Same browser on a phone sheet.
entries.working: Real pages, tabs, honest reader failures, board link.
entries.incomplete: Server reader needs a signed-in deployment; this capture had none, so the Reader says so instead of inventing text.

entries.title: 6 · Every app adapts
entries.changed: One container-query reflow rule for all window content; two-pane apps stack below 640px.
entries.working: Measured clipping 0px in all 10 apps on iPhone (was +124px Agents, +97px Visual Studio).

entries.title: 7 · Reorganising as space changes
entries.changed: 8 windows open while the screen shrinks 1440 → 1024 → 820 → phone.
entries.working: What fits readably is shown; the rest become tabs, still running.
entries.failed: The steward first read the viewport before it settled (one step behind); fixed with a settle read.

entries.title: 8 · Cosmos intact
entries.changed: Nothing removed.
entries.working: Cosmos button, backdrop toggle, Universe round trip keep windows, stage and board.
entries.incomplete: On a phone a full-screen sheet covers the floating backdrop by design.

entries.title: 9 · Workflow 1 — research → creation
entries.changed: Research environment over Wikipedia, Crossref, arXiv and OpenAlex; sources with provenance; browser and board hand-offs; diagram; report from findings.
entries.working: Live retrieval (~24 s); LÉLU opened Research herself; a cited paper in the browser beside the chat; report DOCX + PDF verified.
entries.failed: Found and fixed: auto-staging never fired for commands; split ignored the windows named; the browser was measured wider than the screen; the report was a transcript.
entries.incomplete: Publishers often refuse embedding (Reader/Open offered); the server reader needs a signed-in deployment.

entries.title: 10 · Workflow 2 — visual creation
entries.changed: Gallery compositions: create, restyle, compare versions, export.
entries.working: Two revisions survive a reload; PNG 1200×800 verified with sha256.

entries.title: 11 · Workflow 3 — 3D
entries.changed: Scenes: presets, add/recolour/remove components, GLB/glTF/STL/OBJ, reopen the exported file.
entries.working: GLB 780 KB (glTF ✓) and STL 6.3 MB reopened: 30,272 triangles, same as the live scene.
entries.failed: The viewer was squashed to a strip — fixed.

entries.title: 12 · Workflow 4 — data → explanation → presentation
entries.changed: Live keyless data, interactive charts, findings computed from the chart's numbers, deck, PPTX.
entries.working: USGS M4.5+ week: 120 quakes, peak 24 on Nov 13; PPTX 101.5 KB verified.
entries.failed: First analysis reported a fake 71% fall (today unfinished) — it now says so.

entries.title: 13 · Workflow 5 — film
entries.changed: Storyboard from the conversation → WebM on this device.
entries.working: VP9 · 12 s · 288 frames · soundtrack · 919 KB, EBML ✓, plays.
entries.incomplete: 345–390 s to encode on this GPU-less sandbox (stepped down to 480×270 by measurement); far faster on real hardware.

entries.title: 14 · Workflow 6 — dynamic workspace
entries.changed: Environments keep the work; LÉLU arranges windows from words.
entries.working: 10 environment switches lose nothing; 'beside' and 'tile' with 0 model calls; reload restores.

entries.title: 15 · Workflow 7 — iPhone (research, visual, 3D)
entries.working: Same flows at iPhone 15 Pro size.
entries.failed: Fixed: a maximised window trapped the chat; the browser could open empty.
entries.incomplete: Chromium emulation, not Safari on an iPhone.

entries.title: 16 · Workflow 7 — iPhone (data, workspace, persistence)
entries.working: Data → findings → presentation; one window at a time with tabs; reload restores.

entries.title: 17 · Master integration — research inside the conversation
entries.changed: Freebuff's inline artifacts (520a5d4) + Claude's creative kit + the Chat Universe stages merged on integration/lelu-master-integration.
entries.working: “/research coral reef bleaching”: Wikipedia, Crossref and arXiv read with no model; a cited board and a Mermaid mind map render inside the reply.

entries.title: 18 · A page read in the thread
entries.changed: Freebuff 1ba90af: a guest may read a public page; the page stays in the reply.
entries.working: “/read …Coral_bleaching”: 6,087 characters read, shown in the activity card with Open in LÉLU's browser.
entries.incomplete: The excerpt still starts with the site's navigation text.

entries.title: 19 · A film encoded in its own card
entries.changed: Inline film card (520a5d4) on the Job 2 encoder.
entries.working: Render in the reply → WebM 525 frames VP9 + Opus, 17.52 s (ffprobe).
entries.incomplete: Encoded at 640×360 on this no-GPU machine (encoder measured too slow for 720p).

entries.title: 20 · A 3D file attached in the conversation
entries.changed: GLB/glTF/STL/OBJ attachment re-homed into the redesigned window (merge conflict).
entries.working: A runway GLB attached in the composer opens in three.js inside the thread.

entries.title: 21 · LÉLU AIR organises the results
entries.changed: Large views of the inline artifacts handed to the Workspace Steward.
entries.working: “tile my windows”: four windows 700×372 in a 2×2 grid, 0 overlap, nothing off screen, 0 model calls.
entries.failed: Merged tree: the Steward's stage words stole “make an architecture diagram / a movie / a 3D scene” from the creative kit — fixed with one precedence rule (b0e7e78).

entries.title: 22 · iPhone-sized (Chromium emulation)
entries.changed: Same merged build at 390×844.
entries.working: 3D scene, diagram and live USGS chart as cards 303 px wide, no horizontal overflow.
entries.incomplete: Not real Safari: WebKit is not installed here.

entries.title: 23 · Offline reload, production build
entries.changed: Service worker serves the shell; viewers that cannot load stay inside their card.
entries.working: Sketch made with the network cut, reload offline, back online: every message and artifact present and valid.
entries.failed: The first offline reload showed GENESIS CRASH (Excalidraw chunk not cached) — fixed with EmbedBoundary (64a7d54).
